description: The parts of an imported model (list_elements kind model): each part's id, name and, for IFC, its class (IFCWALL, IFCDOOR…), GlobalId and property sets (e.g. Pset_WallCommon FireRating). Filter by IFC class; paged. Part ids work with select and capture_view mode "element".
name: list_model_parts
title: List a model's parts
